verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Zoho Books supports general financial reporting and accountant access to real-time data/reports (custom reports, 'generating reports'), and MCP/AI hooks claim to 'create financial reports' and 'pull reports', but no evidence specifically documents an Accounts Payable Aging report or a Vendor Balances report, nor any point-in-time snapshot capability for payables. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an AP aging report, a vendor balance summary report, and date-range/point-in-time reporting for payables specifically.
